info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Matching API
info.description: The Product Matching API facilitates the synchronization and update of product information within the banking sales ecosystem. This endpoint allows for patching existing product attributes, ensuring that the data remains current and relevant for sales operations. Typical consumers include banking professionals and sales teams who need to maintain accurate product offerings across various platforms. This API is essential for enhancing customer experience by providing up-to-date product data while streamlining the internal processes of product management.

patch.summary: Update product matching details for a specific product.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the matching details of a specific product identified by its ID. Utilize this endpoint to ensure that the product information in the matching system is current and accurate, facilitating better alignment and visibility across sales platforms.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the product matching details for the specified product ID (PROD-700045). Please ensure that the required fields are included as defined in the schema.
